details: Geopolitical tensions involving the United States and Iran, particularly concerning the Strait of Hormuz, are causing significant volatility in both traditional and cryptocurrency markets. US President Donald Trump has compressed a ceasefire window while maintaining a blockade of the Hormuz Strait, utilizing energy supply risks as leverage. This has led to sustained geopolitical risk expectations and a "pricing divergence period" for the dollar. While equity markets show some resilience, Bitcoin's movements are amplified by the dollar's high volatility, repeatedly testing key support and resistance levels. The situation could lead the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates if energy inflation persists, potentially creating a "bull trap" for Bitcoin's upper liquidity range.
title: Hormuz Tensions and US Policy Fuel Crypto Market Uncertainty

details: Blockchain billionaire Justin Sun has initiated legal action against a cryptocurrency firm associated with the Trump family. The firm, World Liberty, is reportedly facing increasing scrutiny from investors over a lack of transparency. This lawsuit highlights potential governance and transparency issues within celebrity-backed crypto ventures.
title: Justin Sun Sues Trump Family's Crypto Firm Over Transparency
